head.t: DORC brand fully migrates to ZEISS from 1 October 2026, ending as a standalone identity in ophthalmic surgery
head.x: Carl Zeiss Meditec AG has confirmed that the DORC brand is being folded into a single ZEISS brand, two years after ZEISS completed its acquisition of the Dutch Ophthalmic Research Center.
